answer: Vouching with decaying bonds: each new identity only earns after two established peers stake standing on it, and each voucher's score decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. Scaling to N fakes costs N real reputations, and every caught fake leaves a trail of evidence the network replays. The island of honest standing compounds across epochs, the forge of each vouch is public, and the timber of a bad attempt stays replayable, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
